LanguageData.VFEI2_BurnedCreep.label: burned creep
LanguageData.VFEI2_BurnedJellyFloor.label: burned jellyfloor
LanguageData.VFEI2_Creep.description: A unique form of cracked soil, devoid of any minerals and nutrition, created around the insectoid infested areas. Supports insectoid structures and significantly hinders non-insectoid movement.
LanguageData.VFEI2_Creep.label: creep
LanguageData.VFEI2_JellyFloor.description: A special form of gellatinous floor, which sprouts from the creep in insectoid hives. Supports insectoid structures and significantly hinders non-insectoid movement. It’s much less flammable than the creep, and it’s significantly easier to clean.
LanguageData.VFEI2_JellyFloor.label: jellyfloor
LanguageData.VFEI2_RoyalJellyFloor.description: A special form of gellatinous floor consisting of royal jelly, which is created as a result of enriching jellyfloors. Supports insectoid structures and significantly hinders non-insectoid movement. Unlike creep, it’s not flammable, and does not collect animal filth.
LanguageData.VFEI2_RoyalJellyFloor.label: royal jellyfloor
